item.text: {"summary":"The rounding failures point to Floor and Ceil using the signed unit when adjusting a truncated result. The INT64_MIN boundary failure also depends on how division, remainder, and Duration arithmetic behave at the representable limit; the supplied excerpts do not include enough of those paths to specify a concrete repair safely.","hypotheses":["Floor and Ceil adjust with the signed unit, so a negative unit can move the rounded result in the wrong direction.","With a negative three-second unit at INT64_MIN, the rounding adjustment fails to saturate the mathematically out-of-range floor to negative infinity."],"queries":["IDivSlowPath","Duration& Duration::operator-=","Duration& Duration::operator%=","TEST(Duration, Flooring)"],"reads":[{"path":"absl/time/duration.cc","line":350,"symbol":"IDivSlowPath"},{"path":"absl/time/duration.cc","line":419,"symbol":"Duration::operator-="},{"path":"absl/time/duration.cc","line":494,"symbol":"Duration::operator%="},{"path":"absl/time/duration_test.cc","line":1160,"symbol":"TEST(Duration, Truncation)"}],"ready":false}
